purpose: Keep visual design inside the Universal Creation evidence loop: observe bounded source, screenshot pixels, browser runtime state, explicit caller-authored interactions, exact before/after render change, browser accessibility-tree semantics, and bounded CDP Tab traversal; normalize reusable Design Genome state; compose and judge plans; derive bounded repair direction; and bind executed transactional repairs into continuity receipts without granting automatic acceptance or turning measured change into aesthetic truth.

properties.operation: one of inspect-schema, observe-project, derive-genome, validate-genome, compose-plan, judge-plan, materialize, inspect-observer, record-render-observation, judge-rendered, propose-repair, capture-browser, inspect-visual-observer, observe-screenshot, derive-screenshot-genome, observe-render-screenshot, inspect-render-comparison, compare-render-screenshots, inspect-repair-cycle, record-repair-cycle, inspect-cdp-observer, or capture-cdp-semantics
properties.path: materialize target path, browser/CDP evidence output directory, or local PNG screenshot path; relative paths resolve from the machine root
properties.target: capture-browser or capture-cdp-semantics local HTML file or directory containing index.html; URLs are rejected
properties.browser_executable: caller-selected Chromium-compatible executable path or explicit PATH name
properties.viewport_sizes: capture-browser exact map from every design-plan viewport id to width/height and optional device_pixel_ratio
properties.interaction_recipes: capture-browser optional bounded explicit list of recipe ids and focus/activate CSS-selector steps; no interaction crawl is inferred
properties.allow_synthetic_activation: capture-browser optional boolean; defaults false and must be true before any activate step is admitted
properties.viewport: observe-render-screenshot viewport descriptor, compare-render-screenshots exact viewport id, or capture-cdp-semantics exact declared viewport descriptor
properties.keyboard_tab_steps: capture-cdp-semantics optional bounded integer from 0 through 64; Tab is dispatched through Chrome DevTools Protocol and is not claimed as trusted human input
properties.timeout_seconds: bounded browser/CDP timeout from 1 through 120 seconds
properties.observation: derive-genome input using axm.design-observation/v0.1, derive-screenshot-genome input using axm.design-screenshot-observation/v0.1, or judge-rendered input using axm.design-render-observation/v0.1
properties.version: derive-genome or derive-screenshot-genome version, defaults to 0.1.0
properties.purpose: derive-genome or derive-screenshot-genome human-readable design purpose
properties.genome: validate, compose, or materialize axm.design-genome/v0.1 body
properties.request: compose/materialize design request with goal, exact role/component requirements, viewports, and explicit contrast pairs
properties.plan: judge-plan, judge-rendered, capture-browser, or capture-cdp-semantics axm.design-plan/v0.1 body
properties.plan_digest: record-render-observation or observe-render-screenshot exact design-plan digest
properties.observer: record-render-observation attributed observer descriptor: human, browser-tool, model, test-fixture, or other
properties.captures: record-render-observation bounded viewport captures with declared artifacts, measurements, and attributed assessments
properties.required_assessments: judge-rendered optional exact assessment ids; defaults to visual-hierarchy, spacing-consistency, and component-coherence
properties.before_path: compare-render-screenshots local PNG bytes for the before state
properties.after_path: compare-render-screenshots local PNG bytes for the after state
properties.repair_plan: record-repair-cycle axm.design-repair-plan/v0.1 body whose source judgment digest must match before_judgment
properties.repair_result: record-repair-cycle published OBSERVED_TRANSACTIONAL_PROJECT_REPAIR result from existing project-repair machinery
properties.before_observation: compare-render-screenshots or record-repair-cycle exact pre-repair render-observation receipt
properties.after_observation: compare-render-screenshots or record-repair-cycle exact post-repair render-observation receipt
properties.comparison: record-repair-cycle axm.design-render-comparison/v0.1 body bound to before/after observations
properties.replace: materialize only; optional explicit boolean replacement of an existing creation target

anatomy_refs.basis: Design Fabric can observe bounded local project state and materialize design/browser/CDP evidence outside the live machine body while repair-cycle receipts consume existing transactional project-repair evidence.
Material/surface grammar stays explicit while renderer, browser-computed, accessibility-tree, screenshot-pixel, interaction, and repair-delta truth remain separate.
Motion and interaction state stay explicit design state; bounded browser and CDP observations do not silently redefine the underlying grammar.

Source, screenshot, browser runtime, explicit interaction, CDP accessibility/tree and keyboard evidence, repair execution, before/after comparison, and external perception remain digest-bound observations rather than collapsed truth claims.

limitations: local source observation is lexical/structural source inspection and remains distinct from rendered perception
browser/CDP capture requires a caller-selected Chromium-compatible executable and never installs or downloads one automatically
browser and CDP capture accept local HTML targets only; host-resolution blocking, loopback remote debugging, and fresh temporary profiles are not claimed as complete operating-system isolation
runtime and interaction probes run only in temporary instrumented copies and missing markers remain HOLD rather than becoming invented evidence
programmatic focus and synthetic HTMLElement.click are not real keyboard traversal or trusted user input

CDP Tab traversal invokes the browser's Tab navigation through Input.dispatchKeyEvent and reads actual activeElement state, but remains browser-synthetic and does not prove physical keyboard input, user intent, discoverability, assistive-technology behavior, or semantic usability
Accessibility.getFullAXTree is real browser accessibility-tree evidence, but AX node counts, names, and roles are not a WCAG conformance verdict or proof of real assistive-technology output

activate steps are synthetic HTMLElement.click operations, disabled by default, allowed only after explicit authorization, limited to visible button-like controls, and prevented from submitting forms or arbitrarily activating links
interaction PASS proves only that exact caller-supplied recipes completed without recorded probe errors for the exact selectors and viewport; it is not a usability or product-intent claim
rendered contrast is bounded to resolvable opaque computed text/background pairs; complex compositing remains unproven
legacy runtime accessibility findings are bounded DOM heuristics and remain distinct from the newer CDP accessibility-tree artifact
reduced-motion PASS is conservative and does not infer unmeasured mechanisms
the minimal visual observer accepts bounded local 8-bit non-interlaced PNG only and pixel statistics do not prove semantics, hierarchy, spacing quality, beauty, originality, accessibility, or intent
before/after comparison measures exact same-dimension raster change only; dimension mismatch produces HOLD rather than silent resampling
repair-cycle recording requires a published, validation-passed OBSERVED_TRANSACTIONAL_PROJECT_REPAIR result and does not itself apply or approve a source patch
FAIL/HOLD/PASS movement after repair is evidence-gate movement only and is not automatically equivalent to visual-quality improvement or semantic correctness
external perceptual assessments stay attributed observations and are not promoted to objective aesthetic truth

default rendered-quality judgment still requires explicit visual-hierarchy, spacing-consistency, and component-coherence assessments; browser, interaction, CDP, repair, and pixel facts alone cannot manufacture perceptual PASS
a passing integrated judgment or closed repair-cycle receipt applies only to exact supplied plans, artifacts, measurements, recipes, assessments, and viewports and does not grant human acceptance
repair plans are deterministic directions only; no layer silently rewrites source or accepts its own repair
derived genomes retain reference grammar signals without reproducing source page composition by default
persistent_state: none required; optional design descriptors, browser/CDP capture directories, runtime/interaction/accessibility/keyboard JSON, screenshot observations, render comparisons, repair-cycle receipts, and external observations are caller-selected state

truth.basis: Source signals, browser facts, synthetic interaction receipts, CDP accessibility semantics, browser-synthetic keyboard evidence, pixel facts, repair execution, gate transitions, raster deltas, attributed assessments, policy gates, and still-unobserved reality remain separately labeled and digest-bound.

agency.basis: Tokens, browser executable, viewports, CDP tab-step bounds, interaction recipes, activation authority, repair plans, repair execution evidence, comparisons, observers, assessments, gates, provenance, and final acceptance remain inspectable and externally controllable.

continuity.basis: Design Genome, plan digests, browser/CDP observation digests, judgment digests, repair-plan lineage, repair result digest, comparison digest, and cycle digest create explicit continuity across observation and repair without replacing prior meaning.

wisdom-before-speed.basis: Unauthorized activation fails before evidence output, CDP targets stay local, missing endpoints/probes hold or error explicitly, accessibility-tree capture does not self-grant conformance, keyboard dispatch does not masquerade as human input, digest/lineage mismatches fail closed, and even a post-repair PASS does not self-grant acceptance.
